`<StackV>` declares neither `principle` nor `explain` — a layer that says nothing about itself is a layer nobody can test, and nobody can safely delete either. State the seam it is (`principle`) and the reason it exists (`explain`).

JSX file without an `identity` prop on the root — add `identity={{ tier: "…", component: "…" }}` on the root frame/composite (see components/frames/_identity.ts); do not wrap with a hand-rolled data-tier div.

`pages/DashboardPage/` contains `LeagueCard/component.tsx` — a screen folder holds its two halves ONLY (`component.tsx` = the shape, `index.tsx` = the wiring). Whatever this is, it has a real home: a component of its own goes to `blocks/<category>/`, a fetch goes to `hooks/`, a pure helper to `modules/utils/`, a shape to `modules/types/`, copy or a config map to `resources/`. "Only this screen uses it" is how a folder becomes a second codebase.
